doc_friction.issue: The round-3 text blamed the lost TCPD recall on 'short smooth series where the estimated rho is high' without a measurement; the per-series rho showed 15 of 17 losses at the 0.95 clip, mostly long wandering series (Brent 500 points, inventories 330), not short ones.

deviations.why: Rounds 1-3 let the TCPD series decide nothing; round 4 counts them in the pre-registered rule because the fault only shows on real series and synthetic AR(1) cells cannot represent a wandering level at the rho clip.
deviations.did: Rule part (c) on TCPD, written and pushed before the run, with synthetic (a) and (b) kept; README and post say 33 of 52 is no longer held out.
deviations.result: 0.8 cap passed all three parts and became the default; 0.5 cap failed (a).

deviations.why: The rho-frozen-at-baseline candidate named in flagships next: was dropped from round 4 because the diagnostic showed baseline rho at 0.95 on 20 of 30 series, so it cannot help there.
deviations.result: Saved about a third of the replay time.
